title: Standard / rigor / rounds (tmux, fake forge): a standard item record resolves standard and a missing one thorough with flavor-missing, an unreasoned lowering is refused, and a tightening path wins knob-wise; a build with seeded red CI is reviewed by an engine unlike its builder but not validated; the CI fix supersedes the red head with a fresh review; precheck refuses missing, stale, failed, foreign and wrong-item reports and passes the repaired one; changes return findings once; the round-2 fix gets a fresh review and validation with no copied verdict, is approved to the synthesizer once and closed out on merge; an escalated change starts no review
